gameplay_loops.label: The Debt Cycle
gameplay_loops.summary: Players acquire high-value information, trade it to reduce their debt, and use their new leverage to acquire more secrets.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Interest rates rise every hour of real-time play.

gameplay_loops.label: The Liquidation Game
gameplay_loops.summary: Players identify vulnerable targets, build a social coalition to isolate them, and split the assets once the target is liquidated.
gameplay_loops.pressure: The target can counter-sue if they find a flaw in the coalition's logic.

player_entry_points: A disgraced heir seeking to reclaim a stolen family ledger.
A debt-collector looking for a legendary 'unpayable' contract.
A curator attempting to hide the insolvency of the museum's main wing.
conflict_hooks: The Great Ledger has been tampered with, swapping the debts of the elite with the poor.
A new 'Infinite Debt' has appeared, threatening to crash the social economy.
The Museum Director is auctioning off the literal 'Future' of a prominent city-state.
custom_actions: Audit Legacy: Investigate a rival's ancestral debt history.
Collateralize Memory: Trade a personal memory to delay a payment.
Foreclose Influence: Force a peer to use their social standing for your benefit.
social_rules: All debts are public record but their origins are private.
Direct physical violence results in immediate asset liquidation.
Silence during a negotiation is legally binding as consent.
Status is measured by the duration of one's future obligations.

visual_consistency_rules: 1px selective black outline for all sprites.
No gradients; use dithering for frosted glass effects.
Red is reserved for high-status or high-danger elements.
All props must be held at 90-degree angles to the body.
Shadows must be cast strictly downward at 100% opacity.
